applies_to: F03 and every later family. F01 and F02 are audited, not redesigned here.
top_control_safe_zone: Back, wordmark, and info may sit near the safe top.
intro_start_zone: The family title begins below the chrome with a deliberate gap. It does not sit against the controls.
content_safe_zone: Primary type, panels, and amounts stay inside the content rail.
environment_breathing_zone: The right side of an environment plate stays open. Content does not cover the curtain, sky, or architecture.
panel_width_policy: If content does not fit, refine type and spacing before widening the panel into the plate.
bottom_centering_policy: The bottom nav is centered in the app canvas. Inner labels stay left-aligned inside rows.

typographic_containment.summary: Interactive text stays compact. Reduce size and tracking before wrapping. An underline fits the text, not the parent.
typographic_containment.applies_to: ALL JURNL user-facing text, F01 through F16, every viewport. Priority: clickable text, inline actions, text links, secondary actions, LEARN MORE / SEE WHY / SKIP / CONNECT / EDIT labels, compact navigation labels.
typographic_containment.single_line: A short or medium clickable label (32 characters or fewer) reads as one action: one line, one row, one compact interactive unit.
typographic_containment.never: increase_container_width_into_environment, unless the authority explicitly requires it
typographic_containment.environment: Clickable text never moves into the environment breathing zone to avoid a wrap. Type keeps clear of the white curtain: F02 measures it against hand-traced plate edges (28 px phone, 44 px tablet, 60 px desktop); every family is probed for sheer white pixels just right of each bare label.
typographic_containment.rule_width: FIT_CONTENT. An underline or rule is text-decoration on the label, so it follows the text footprint on every line, never the parent container.
typographic_containment.multiline: Allowed only when compression would push the label below the readable floor. Then the label keeps its size and wraps balanced, under a rule that follows each line. Never an accidental browser wrap.
typographic_containment.minimum_readable_note: Compact fit never pushes an interactive label below 10 px. Labels already designed at 9.5 px only lose tracking. Navigation labels are 10 px.
typographic_containment.tap_target: Visual size and hit area are separate. Every control is at least 24 × 24 px. Inline links grow their hit area with an absolutely positioned ::before (inset -7px -2px), not with bigger type.
typographic_containment.responsive: Re-evaluated at 393×852, 834×1194 and 1440×900. A label may be smaller on a phone than on tablet or desktop if that keeps the same composition.
typographic_containment.implementation: useCompactFit() in src/projects/jurnl/runtime/components/primitives.tsx runs the order above on every JurnlButton, JurnlTextLink (standalone), JurnlChoice and clickable JurnlRow label after layout, on font load and on resize. A label that already fits is left untouched. data-jrn-fit records the strategy used: size, tracking, size-floor or controlled-wrap.

icon_label_row: Icon, then label, then optional control, on one row. A wrapping label stays in its own column.
money_formatting: User-facing money uses formatMoney and the active currency symbol.
currency_preference: Global display currency. No foreign-exchange conversion.

responsive_rules.tablet: 834x1194. Wider rail, still short of the plate. Larger intro gap.
responsive_rules.desktop: 1440x900. Rail stays editorial. Nav stays a centered dock, not a full-bleed bar.
